daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Former special staff member to a minister, Gus Alex, denied charges that he received US$5.2 million and Rp 330 million in the haji quota corruption case during his trial. The KPK revealed the money flow scheme in the haji quota case and announced the seizure of Rp 100 billion in assets. Separately, the Attorney General's Office cancelled the inauguration of Rinaldi Umar as Director of Education at the Special Crimes Directorate.

  • Hanura party proposed a combined open-closed electoral system for the 2029 elections.
  • Megawati inaugurated Pinka Haprani to lead Taruna Merah Putih, targeting 56 percent of the youth vote.
  • The KPK questioned Rudi Tanoe alongside BPKP auditors regarding state losses in the social aid corruption case.
  • The Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture denied rumors of resigning from the cabinet due to illness.
  • The Attorney General inaugurated 15 chief prosecutors and several echelon II officials.
  • A high court in Mataram rejected the public prosecutor's appeal of acquittals for three West Nusa Tenggara provincial council members.
  • The Ministry of Transportation committed to follow up all BPK recommendations to strengthen financial governance.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense met Defence Minister Sjafrie to discuss the continuation of bilateral defence cooperation between Indonesia and the United States. The Indonesian Air Force is strengthening air defence capabilities by boosting both its aircraft fleet and pilot quality.

  • The Foreign Ministry confirmed that Indonesian crew members were victims of an attack in the Bab Al-Mandeb strait off Yemen.
  • The Foreign Ministry continues to monitor seven Indonesian crew members aboard the MV Star Janet in Chinese waters.
  • Indonesia will renew cooperation with the IOM on migrant worker protection.
  • Ambassador Witjaksono affirmed ASEAN's commitment to strengthen partnership with Kenya.
  • The Foreign Ministry launched a task force for IORA 2026 to strengthen diplomacy in the Indian Ocean region.

Other

The government will establish a cross-ministerial task force to resolve agrarian conflicts across the country. The Ministry of Home Affairs is transforming land services to close loopholes exploited by land mafia. The Energy and Mineral Resources Minister said energy revenues will surpass targets this year.

  • The government will restrict Pertalite subsidies for upper income deciles in phases while ensuring supply remains secure despite global shocks.
  • The MSME Ministry and OJK signed an MoU to expand financing and market access for micro, small and medium enterprises.
  • The government launched digitalization of birth certificate issuance, enabling newborns to receive certificates immediately.
  • Indonesia is speeding up charging station expansion to match electric vehicle growth.
  • The Head of BGN affirmed a zero tolerance policy for poisoning from school meal programs (MBG), saying safety cannot be compromised.
